STANDARD_SAMPLE_RATES.doc: The standard sample rates (Hz) the desk recognises — the pro-audio superset. One source of truth for the clock controller's `clock.allowed-rates` seed, the force row's validation ceiling and the device-rate probe fallback. What the operator is OFFERED is always the DEVICE's own `supportedRates` (`2026-07-15-clock-rate-honest-force-rate.md`) — this is the ceiling a write is refused by, never a menu.

DSP_KNOB_REFERENCE_RATE.doc: The rate a unit-range DSP knob is quoted at (R-058): the rate this desk runs (ruling 2026-09-14). A kernel raises the knob to `REF / sr`, so at this rate the exponent is exactly 1 and the response is bit-for-bit the one cut before the law. Emitted to C as `OMX_DSP_KNOB_REFERENCE_RATE`; the reverb damping and FX-delay tone references `#define` from it.
